description: Named command rulesets. Each ruleset supplies the IOS commands emitted per condition, plus the policy the wizard follows. Edit these in git so a whole team generates identical config; {cgNum}, {cgMode} and {vlan} are substituted from the port group.

access-switch.name: Access Switch
access-switch.description: 802.1X on by default, ';' descriptions with ZB on unsecured ports, and uplinks bundled into a desirable port-channel.

distribution-switch.name: Distribution Switch
distribution-switch.description: Routed distribution layer: management addressed on Loopback0, no 802.1X, optional StackWise Virtual.

deviceToggles.label: StackWise Virtual
deviceToggles.hint: Emits the global StackWise Virtual block. Assign the SVL links on the member interfaces themselves.
